question: Olimpia Milano vs. Reyer Venezia: O/U 174.5
description:
In the upcoming Serie A game between Olimpia Milano and Reyer Venezia, scheduled for June 13 at 2:00 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Over" if Olimpia Milano and Reyer Venezia combine to score 175 or more points in this game.

If the combined total is less than 175, this market will resolve to "Under".

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.

The result will be determined based on the final score including any overtime periods. This market will resolve according to the official final score published on flashscoreusa.com.
